lines.t: Walk the narrow path of mercy, turn away from shadow's call
Hold your heart in sacred honor, let your spirit never fall
Every whisper yields a choice, I is every step a solemn vow
To seek the truth in all creation and live as holy conscience allows
You shall guard what's pure and rightfully the earth, what's stained and flawed
Turn away from all defilement, send in grace before your God
Temptation waits with gentle promise
But wisdom speaks with steady flame
Walk with courage through the silence
And rise above the weight of shame
Every breath can cleanse the soul
Every eye can light the dark
When your will aligns with heaven
You reflect the Father's spark
You shall guard what's pure and rightful
Leave behind what's stained and flawed
Turn away from all defilements
Stand in grace before your God
Let your heart be strong, unbroken Let your faith be firm and true
For the eyes of God are watching And His mercy covers you
You shall guard what's pure and rightful
Seek his way, obey his call
Turn from sin and worldly shadows
Stand in the light that claims us all
